page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i5e.4xlarge is an instance within the Local SSDs family, architected for high-throughput data processing and storage-heavy deployments. Powered by a KVM hypervisor on an x86_64 architecture, the instance provides 16 dedicated vCPUs driven by an Intel Xeon 6763P-C processor clocked at 2.9 GHz. It includes 128.0 GB of system memory, maintaining an 8.0 GB per vCPU allocation, without integrated GPU hardware.

A central component of this configuration is its integrated 7679 GB local SSD storage volume, paired with a baseline network throughput of 40 Gbps. Bundling extensive direct-attached solid-state capacity inside the host avoids the latency overhead associated with network-attached block volumes. The balanced combination of high network bandwidth and substantial local disk space provides strong I/O capacity for data-intensive processing.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the inclusion of direct-attached storage alongside a generous 1:8 core-to-memory ratio provides dense resource utilization. Environments requiring co-located compute, sizable storage footprints, and rapid I/O benefit from this unified architecture over deploying separate external storage solutions. Potential architectural tradeoffs include managing instance-local storage persistence and working within the dedicated 16 vCPU capacity boundary.

This hardware profile is optimal for distributed NoSQL databases, transactional data stores, search indexing engines, real-time log analytics, and extract-transform-load (ETL) pipelines requiring rapid disk writes alongside consistent memory capacity.
